system.description: The Point-Blank Range of any Rifle or Carbine you use is increased by 5 squares. Short Range for the Weapon begins 5 squares later, but still ends at the same distance. You can take this Talent up to two times; each time you take this Talent, you increase the Point-Blank Range of any Rifle or Carbine you use by an additional 5 squares, up to a maximum of 10 squares.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Legacy Era Campaign Guide
